name: GlucoTwin twin-validity protocol, addendum v4: post-meal walk effect estimator (cohort level)
registered: 2026-10-23, written before scripts/validate_walk_whatif.py was implemented or run
status: Pre-specified. No walk-effect estimate has been computed on any split before this file was written.
scope: Synthetic simulator cohort only (seed 20261017; split train 36 / validation 12 / test 12 patients). Research estimator shown in the dashboard as a labelled research estimate; the frozen engine, tree models and their What-If numbers are unchanged. Not clinical evidence; not exercise advice.
why_not_the_tree_model: The served models see activity only as steps in the 30 and 60 min BEFORE the forecast moment (features steps_30, steps_60). A walk planned after the meal is future activity that no model input represents, so a feature-perturbation walk What-If would answer a different question ('had they walked before eating'). It is therefore not built.
why_cohort_level: The twin learns one personal parameter (carb sensitivity). It has no learned per-patient activity sensitivity, so every walk estimator here is cohort level and is labelled as such.

intervention.meal: g grams of true carbohydrate at the anchor minute a, spread over 15 min (as the generator does); g in {20, 25, 35, 36, 40, 45, 50, 60, 90, 120}
intervention.walk: +125 steps/min for 20 min (2,500 steps) starting at a + 15 min, added to the patient's existing steps; the generator's activity cap (steps/100 clipped at 1.3) applies unchanged
intervention.truth: W(h) = noiseless interstitial glucose with meal + walk minus with meal only, paired with common random numbers (same hidden parameters, schedule and stress days), at h = +30, +60, +120 min after the meal

anchors: every patient x the 32 replay offsets of protocol v1 (OFFSETS_H), anchor = latest CGM reading at first observation + offset; eligible if that reading <= 180 mg/dL. All 10 meal sizes per anchor.

data_use.train (36 patients): fits every candidate's parameters from simulator truth W(h)
data_use.validation (12 patients): selects one candidate by the lowest mean of validation MAEs at +30/+60/+120 min; ties resolved in the listed order
data_use.test (12 patients): scored once with the selected candidate

candidates.estimate: W_hat(g, h) = mean train W(h) for that meal size
W_hat(h) = beta_h x latest CGM at the anchor, beta_h = least squares through the origin on train

comparators_on_test: no walk effect (W_hat = 0): what the served tree What-If and the meal-only twin curve implicitly assume
metrics: direction accuracy where |W| >= 2 mg/dL (reported with the share of negative true W)
inference: paired patient bootstrap over the 12 test patients, 1,000 resamples, seed 20261017, 95% percentile CIs for MAE and RMSE differences (selected minus comparator)
disclosures: The simulator's exercise term is -ex_gain x activity x G, with ex_gain uniform 0.012-0.024 per patient; glucose_scaled mirrors that structure, so its accuracy is a best case for this simulator.
The size of any walk effect here is a property of the simulator's built-in exercise model, not evidence about real walking.
served_twin_curve: The meal-only personalised curve served alongside the tree What-If is the addendum v3 selected estimator: delta = k_h x grams x s(t0), k_h = selected_alpha_h x c_median(h) from reports/research/twin_and_whatif_validation.json (3-decimal values, product rounding changes predictions by < 0.6%). It is a research estimate, flagged 'outside tested range' when grams are outside 20-120 g or the latest CGM is above 180 mg/dL (the v3 test conditions).
